answer: If account A sits on the panel for B's answer, the draw won't put B on any of A's panels for the next 30 epochs. Grading only flows one way between any pair. Honest graders never notice, since with hundreds in the pool the odds of drawing your own grader back are tiny anyway. A farm notices. Its whole trick is back-scratching, where B's clone grades A's sonnet about a lantern shop and A returns the favor on B's plume tracking report. With returns blocked, every favor needs a fresh account that hasn't been graded by the other side, so the ring has to keep growing just to stay even.
